title: Plank Fix + Dead Bug
style: Isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, clean white background, beautiful consistent mobile ad look, portrait 2:3 composition.
character: Same 19–20-year-old adult character in every slide, fully clothed in a fitted pastel tank top, athletic shorts, and simple sneakers; friendly face, athletic-but-natural build, consistent hairstyle, colors, and proportions.
voice: Upbeat, friendly, brisk delivery with clear emphasis on the fix words.

exercises.name: PLANK
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Same young adult character on a pastel exercise mat in a forearm plank viewed from a front three-quarter isometric angle. WRONG form: elbows and forearms touch the floor, elbows slightly too far forward from shoulders, palms flat, toes touch the floor, legs straight, knees lifted, but hips sag clearly downward below the shoulder-to-ankle line, belly droops toward the mat, lower back over-arched, shoulders shrugged toward ears, neck slightly strained. Same camera angle and framing as pose b.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Same young adult character on the same pastel exercise mat in a forearm plank viewed from the same front three-quarter isometric angle. RIGHT form: elbows directly under shoulders, forearms parallel and pressing into the floor, palms flat, toes touch the floor, legs straight, knees lifted, glutes lightly squeezed, ribs tucked, hips lifted into one straight line from head through shoulders, hips, knees, and heels, neck long with gaze down. Same camera angle and framing as pose a.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Same young adult character lying on their back on the same pastel exercise mat, viewed from a front three-quarter isometric angle. Correct dead bug start position: back and head touch the mat, lower back gently close to the floor, both arms straight upward above shoulders with hands open, hips and knees bent to right angles, shins parallel to the floor, feet lifted, calm face, neck relaxed. Same camera angle and framing as pose b.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Same young adult character lying on their back on the same pastel exercise mat, viewed from the same front three-quarter isometric angle. Correct dead bug extended position: back and head touch the mat, lower back gently close to the floor, right arm reaches long overhead near the floor without touching, left leg extends straight outward low above the mat, left arm remains vertical above shoulder, right knee remains bent over hip with shin parallel to floor, opposite limbs clearly lengthened, core controlled, neck relaxed. Same camera angle and framing as pose a.

result: Portrait 2:3 isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Same young adult character standing tall and relaxed on the pastel mat, feet hip-width apart, knees soft, shoulders down and back, chest open, neck long, chin gently level, arms relaxed at sides, proud happy smile, confident upright posture.

lines.hook: Hips sagging? Your plank is training slouch, not support.
lines.ex1: Squeeze glutes; keep ribs tucked and head to heels straight.
lines.ex2: Dead bugs build control so your spine stays long.
lines.takeaway: Two minutes daily: slow reps, tall posture.
